description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the class 'Language' within the OpenCart Admin Controller Event namespace, responsible for handling language-related events such as indexing and lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Class handling the event-driven operations related to language management within the admin controller namespace. It extends the base Controller class and provides methods for index, before, and after hooks to manipulate language data during application lifecycle events.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads all language variables and ensures they are available in the template context, setting defaults if necessary.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Stores a backup of the current language data before a controller action executes, serializing the data into JSON.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language data from the backup JSON after a controller action completes, applying the stored language variables back into the session.
